summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various integration efforts, particularly with Spark, focusing on topics like variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, there are ongoing discussions about optimizing GitHub Actions usage and addressing challenges related to column update file representation and metadata.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes on variant support and DSv2 API upgrades
Strategies to reduce GitHub Actions consumption due to high usage
Discussion on column update file representation with deletion vectors
Tracking issue for upcoming iceberg-rust v0.10.0 release
